meta.note: ceiling audit of the centroid feature set: best achievable separation by any rule + the label-provenance caveat. discoveryClaim false, safeToGate false.

verdict: P109-CENTROID-CEILING (the best blend/planet separation the whole pixel-centroid feature set can reach on 59 testable blends / 55 testable planets, offline): target-p AUC 0.479 (none), neighbour-p AUC 0.669 (weak), 2-feature composite AUC 0.570, best viable-neighbour stratum AUC 0.681 -> CEILING = 0.681 (weak); best achievable Youden J = 0.37 (neighbour 0.36, conjunction 0.37); at a <=5% planet-false-reject budget the neighbour axis flags only 0.17 of blends. Two things close the centroid line: (1) no rule -- single axis, the p82 conjunction, a composite, or a stratified sub-population -- clears the 0.7 usable bar, confirming p104/p106 now with an explicit ceiling; (2) decisively, these planet/blend LABELS come from the p82 injection/validation harness, NOT external confirmed difference-imaging, so even a ceiling above 0.7 would not be independent validation of a real candidate -- the axis stays diagnostic-only and cannot be fed favourably to the gate. usable=false. discoveryClaim false, safeToGate false.
